name: Overnight oats with berries and chia
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia, and cinnamon together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).
Top with blueberries and eat cold, or microwave 1 minute if you prefer it warm.

swaps.then: Use certified gluten-free oats.
Use lactose-free milk and lactose-free or plant yogurt.
Use fortified soy milk and a soy or oat yogurt; same method.

name: Peanut butter banana toast
steps: Toast the bread if you have a toaster; skip if not.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with banana slices and a pinch of cinnamon.

swaps.then: Use sunflower seed butter or almond butter.
Use gluten-free bread or brown rice cakes.

name: Greek yogurt parfait with strawberries and walnuts
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a bowl or jar.
Layer strawberries, oats, and walnuts, then the rest of the yogurt.
Drizzle with honey.

swaps.then: Use pumpkin seeds instead of walnuts.
Greek yogurt is lower in lactose; use lactose-free yogurt if you still react.
Skip the honey; the berries are sweet enough.

name: Spinach and red pepper egg scramble
steps: Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook the pepper 2 minutes.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Whisk eggs with pepper, pour in, and stir gently until just set.

swaps.then: Use 200 g crumbled firm tofu with a pinch of turmeric; cook the same way.
Use kale or zucchini instead of spinach.

name: Microwave egg and cheese mug scramble

ingredients.display: 1 slice whole-wheat toast, on the side

steps: Whisk eggs, milk, and pepper in a large microwave-safe mug.
Stir in spinach and cheese.
Microwave 45 seconds, stir, then 30 to 45 seconds more until just set.
Serve with the toast.

swaps.then: Leave out the cheese and use water instead of milk.
Cheddar is very low in lactose; use lactose-free milk.

name: Steel-cut oats with apple, cinnamon, and walnuts (batch)
steps: Bring water to a boil and stir in oats.
Reduce to a simmer and cook 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in apple and cinnamon in the last 5 minutes.
Serve topped with walnuts and a drizzle of maple syrup. Refrigerate extra portions up to 4 days.

swaps.then: Use certified gluten-free steel-cut oats.
Use sunflower seeds.
Use a firm banana or blueberries instead of apple.

name: Zucchini, pepper, and feta frittata
steps: Heat oven to 375 F. Microwave the diced potatoes 3 minutes.
Cook potatoes, onion, pepper, and zucchini in oil in an oven-safe skillet for 6 minutes.
Whisk eggs, milk, and pepper; pour over vegetables and scatter feta on top.
Cook 2 minutes on the stove, then bake 15 to 18 minutes until set in the center.
Cool 5 minutes, slice into wedges.

swaps.then: Leave out the onion; use scallion green tops.
Skip the feta and use water instead of milk.
Skip the feta.

name: Blender banana oat pancakes

ingredients.display: 1/2 tbsp canola oil for the pan

steps: Blend everything except the oil until smooth.
Let the batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4-cup pancakes and cook 2 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with fruit.

swaps.then: Use certified gluten-free oats.
Use 2 tbsp ground flaxseed mixed with 6 tbsp water.
Use lactose-free or oat milk.

name: Turmeric tofu scramble with peppers and spinach
steps: Press or pat the tofu dry, then crumble it with your hands.
Heat oil over medium heat and cook the pepper 3 minutes.
Add tofu, turmeric, garlic powder, and pepper; cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Fold in spinach and scallions until wilted.

swaps.then: Use 4 eggs instead of tofu.
Skip the garlic powder and use only the green tops of the scallions.

name: Cottage cheese bowl with pineapple and almonds
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with pineapple and almonds.

notes.sodium_tip: Cottage cheese carries most of the sodium here; look for a no-salt-added or lower-sodium brand.

swaps.then: Use sunflower or pumpkin seeds.
Use lactose-free cottage cheese or plain Greek yogurt.

name: Berry spinach protein smoothie
steps: Add milk and yogurt to the blender first, then spinach, fruit, and flax.
Blend until smooth, about 1 minute.

swaps.then: Use fortified soy milk and soy yogurt.
Use lactose-free milk; Greek yogurt is already low in lactose.
Leave out the spinach.

name: Avocado toast with a fried egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and pepper and spread on the toast.
Fry the egg in oil over medium heat until the white is set; slide it on top.

swaps.then: Use gluten-free bread.
Keep avocado to 2 tbsp or use hummus.
Top with 1/2 cup white beans warmed with olive oil.

name: Egg and black bean breakfast burrito
steps: Scramble eggs in oil over medium heat until just set.
Warm the tortilla 20 seconds in the microwave or a dry pan.
Fill with eggs, beans, cheese, and salsa; fold and roll.
Wrap extras in foil and refrigerate; reheat 60 seconds.

notes.sodium_tip: The tortilla and salsa are the salt sources; a corn tortilla cuts about 300 mg.

swaps.then: Use 2 corn tortillas.
Leave out the beans and add diced red pepper.
Skip the cheese; add avocado.

name: Savory oatmeal with a soft egg and scallions
steps: Simmer oats in water 5 minutes until creamy.
Meanwhile fry the egg in oil until the white is set.
Stir parmesan and pepper into the oats, top with the egg and scallion greens.

swaps.then: Use certified gluten-free oats.
Skip the parmesan.
Top with 1/3 cup warmed lentils instead.

name: Chia pudding with mango
steps: Whisk chia, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar.
Whisk again after 5 minutes so it does not clump; refrigerate overnight.
Top with mango.

swaps.then: Use oat milk or lactose-free milk.
Use 1/2 cup strawberries or kiwi instead of mango.

name: Sweet potato and pepper hash with eggs
steps: Microwave the diced sweet potato 3 minutes to give it a head start.
Cook sweet potato in oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes until browning.
Add onion, pepper, and paprika; cook 5 minutes more.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 4 minutes until whites set.

swaps.then: Skip the onion; use scallion greens at the end.
Top with black beans and avocado instead.

name: Egg white omelet with mushrooms and spinach
steps: Cook mushrooms in oil over medium heat 4 minutes; add spinach until wilted and set aside.
Whisk egg whites, egg, and pepper; pour into the same pan.
When nearly set, add the vegetables and cheese to one half and fold over.

swaps.then: Skip the cheese.
Use red bell pepper instead of mushrooms.

name: Microwave peanut butter banana oatmeal
steps: Combine oats and milk in a large microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave 2 minutes, stir, then 1 minute more.
Stir in peanut butter; top with banana and cinnamon.

swaps.then: Use certified gluten-free oats.
Use water or fortified soy milk.
Use almond or sunflower seed butter.

name: Shakshuka (eggs poached in pepper tomato sauce)
steps: Cook onion and pepper in oil over medium heat 6 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; stir 30 seconds.
Pour in tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes to thicken.
Make 4 wells and crack an egg into each; cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until whites set.
Scatter feta and parsley over the top.

notes.sodium_tip: Canned tomatoes and feta bring the salt; buy no-salt-added tomatoes to cut about 200 mg.

swaps.then: Leave out onion and garlic; use scallion greens and a pinch more cumin.
Skip the feta.
Not a good fit; choose the veggie egg scramble instead.

name: Warm cinnamon quinoa bowl with raspberries
steps: Combine quinoa, milk, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Microwave 90 seconds and stir.
Top with raspberries, almonds, and honey.

swaps.then: Use lactose-free or almond milk.
Use pumpkin seeds.

name: Turkey sausage and egg English muffin
steps: Cook the sausage links in a pan over medium heat 8 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Toast the muffin.
Fry the egg in oil until the white is set.
Stack sausage, egg, and cheese on the muffin.

notes.sodium_tip: Sausage, muffin, and cheese add up to about 800 mg; skip the cheese or use half a muffin to cut it.

swaps.then: Use a 2 oz patty of plain ground turkey seasoned with sage and pepper.
Use a gluten-free English muffin or serve over sauteed potatoes.

name: Tuna and white bean salad

ingredients.display: 2 cans (5 oz) light tuna in water, drained

steps: Flake the tuna into a bowl.
Add beans, onion, celery, and parsley.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, and pepper. Serve over greens or with whole-grain bread.

notes.sodium_tip: Canned tuna and canned beans are the salt here; rinsing the beans and choosing no-salt-added tuna cuts it by about a third.

swaps.then: Use 1 1/2 cups diced cooked chicken breast.
Use a second can of tuna and 1 cup diced cucumber in place of the beans.
Leave out the red onion; use scallion green tops.

name: Hummus and vegetable pita plate
steps: Arrange hummus, pita wedges, and vegetables on a plate.
Dip and eat.

notes.sodium_tip: Store hummus runs about 130 mg per 2 tbsp; a lower-sodium brand helps.

swaps.then: Use a tahini-free hummus or mashed white beans with olive oil and lemon.
Use brown rice cakes or corn tortilla wedges instead of pita.
Keep hummus to 2 tbsp; fill up on cucumber and carrots.

name: Rotisserie chicken and veggie wrap
steps: Mix yogurt and mustard and spread on the tortilla.
Layer chicken, romaine, tomato, and cucumber.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.

notes.sodium_tip: Rotisserie chicken is injected with salt solution (about 300 mg per 3 oz); plain cooked chicken breast cuts this wrap to about 450 mg.

swaps.then: Use a large lettuce leaf or corn tortillas.
Use mustard alone or a dab of olive oil.

name: Canned salmon salad in lettuce cups

ingredients.display: 1 small can (3.5 oz) pink salmon, drained

steps: Flake salmon, mashing any soft bones in.
Stir in yogurt, mayo, celery, scallion, dill, and lemon.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and eat with rice cakes.

notes.sodium_tip: Canned salmon carries about 380 mg; no-salt-added cans exist.

swaps.then: Use 1/2 cup mashed chickpeas.
Skip the mayo; use all yogurt.
Use only the green tops of the scallion.

name: Microwave black bean and cheese quesadilla

ingredients.display: 1/3 cup low-sodium black beans, rinsed and lightly mashed

steps: Spread mashed beans on one tortilla; sprinkle with cumin and cheese.
Top with the second tortilla and place on a plate.
Microwave 60 to 90 seconds until the cheese melts. Cut in wedges and serve with salsa.

notes.sodium_tip: Salsa and cheese are the salt; low-sodium beans keep the total near 500 mg.

swaps.then: Skip the cheese and add mashed avocado after heating.
Use 1/4 cup canned lentils (rinsed) or shredded chicken instead of beans.

name: Hearty lentil vegetable soup (batch)

ingredients.display: 2 cups dry brown or green lentils, rinsed

steps: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in oil over medium heat 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cumin; stir 1 minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth; bring to a boil, then simmer 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in spinach and lemon juice. For a smoother soup, blend half and stir it back in.
Cool and refrigerate up to 5 days or freeze.

notes.sodium_tip: Made with water and no added salt, so the tomatoes are the only salt source; regular broth would add about 350 mg per bowl.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; use the green tops of a bunch of scallions and canned lentils (rinsed) at 1/2 cup per serving.
Use chopped kale instead of spinach.

name: Greek chickpea salad
steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk oil, lemon, and oregano; pour over and toss.
Top with feta. Keeps 2 days.

notes.sodium_tip: Feta and olives add about 280 mg per serving; halve them for a lower-sodium version.

swaps.then: Skip the feta; add 2 tbsp toasted sunflower seeds.
Use 1/4 cup chickpeas per serving and add 3 oz cooked chicken.
Leave out the red onion.

name: Turkey and bean chili (batch)

ingredients.display: 1 can (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed

steps: Brown the turkey in oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and pepper; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin, and oregano for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve plain or over brown rice. Freezes well.

notes.sodium_tip: Chili powder blends and canned beans carry salt; rinsing beans and using low-sodium cans keeps this near 500 mg.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens and add the beans at 1/4 cup per serving.
Use 1 tbsp chili powder and skip any cayenne.
Use 2 more cans of beans and 1 cup diced sweet potato for a vegetarian chili.

name: Turkey and avocado sandwich (fresh roast turkey)

ingredients.display: 3 oz sliced roast turkey breast (home-cooked, not deli)

steps: Spread avocado on one slice and mustard on the other.
Layer turkey, tomato, and lettuce; close and cut.

notes.sodium_tip: Home-roasted turkey has about 100 mg per 3 oz; deli turkey would add 600 mg or more.

swaps.then: Use gluten-free bread or wrap in lettuce.
Use 1 tbsp avocado or swap in hummus.

name: Quinoa black bean bowls with lime and avocado

ingredients.display: 2 cans (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed

steps: Simmer quinoa in water, covered, 15 minutes; let stand 5 minutes and fluff.
Meanwhile warm beans and corn together in a small pan or the microwave.
Whisk lime juice, oil, and cumin.
Divide quinoa into bowls; top with beans, corn, pepper, avocado, cilantro, and salsa; drizzle with dressing.

notes.sodium_tip: Salsa is the main salt source; low-sodium beans keep the bowl around 450 mg.

swaps.then: Use 3 oz grilled chicken per bowl and only 1/4 cup beans.
Use 2 tbsp avocado per bowl.

name: Lighter egg salad sandwich
steps: Mash eggs with yogurt, mayo, mustard, celery, and pepper.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.

swaps.then: Use gluten-free bread or serve on cucumber rounds.
Use all mayo or a lactose-free yogurt.

name: Cold peanut noodle bowls with edamame
steps: Cook pasta per package; rinse under cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime, honey, sriracha, ginger, and warm water until smooth.
Toss noodles with sauce, cabbage, carrot, edamame, cucumber, and scallions.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

notes.sodium_tip: Uses low-sodium soy sauce (about 500 mg per serving from the sauce); regular soy sauce would nearly double it.

swaps.then: Use rice noodles and tamari or coconut aminos.
Use sunflower seed butter or tahini.
Use coconut aminos and swap edamame for shredded chicken.

name: Chicken salad with grapes and walnuts
steps: Stir yogurt, mayo, lemon, and pepper together.
Fold in chicken, grapes, walnuts, and celery.
Serve over romaine or in a whole-wheat pita.

swaps.then: Use sunflower seeds.
Skip mayo; use all yogurt.
Use all mayo or lactose-free yogurt.

name: Mediterranean tuna pita

ingredients.display: 1 can (5 oz) light tuna in water, drained

steps: Mix tuna with yogurt, lemon, oil, parsley, and olives.
Stuff pita halves with tuna, cucumber, and tomato.

notes.sodium_tip: Tuna, pita, and olives total about 550 mg; no-salt-added tuna drops it to about 350.

swaps.then: Use 1/2 cup mashed chickpeas.
Serve in lettuce cups or with corn tortillas.

name: Minestrone with white beans and kale (batch)
steps: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in oil 6 minutes.
Add garlic, zucchini, green beans, and herbs; cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Add beans and pasta; simmer 10 minutes until pasta is tender.
Stir in kale until wilted. Serve with parmesan.

notes.sodium_tip: Vegetable broth cut with water and rinsed beans keep this near 650 mg a bowl; a low-sodium broth brings it under 400. Parmesan adds about 60 mg per tablespoon.

swaps.then: Use brown rice pasta or 1 cup cooked rice.
Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens and swap the pasta for rice.
Skip the parmesan.

name: Blended black bean soup with lime

ingredients.display: 3 cans (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed
1/4 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt, for topping

steps: Cook onion in oil over medium heat 5 minutes; add garlic, cumin, and chili powder for 1 minute.
Add beans and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth (use an immersion blender or blend in batches with the lid vented).
Stir in lime juice; top with cilantro, avocado, and a spoon of yogurt.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium beans and broth cut with water keep this around 600 mg per bowl; low-sodium vegetable broth brings it under 400.

swaps.then: Not a good fit during elimination; try the carrot ginger soup instead.
Top with avocado instead of yogurt.
Skip the yogurt topping.

name: Simple chicken, cucumber, and rice bowls
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips; toss with ginger and pepper.
Cook in oil over medium-high heat 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
Divide rice into bowls; top with chicken, cucumber, carrot, scallion greens, and dill.

notes.sodium_tip: No salt added; about 100 mg per bowl. Add a pinch at the table if you need it.

swaps.then: Use 12 oz fresh cod or tilapia; cook 4 minutes per side.
Use brown rice or quinoa.

name: Vegetable egg fried rice
steps: Scramble eggs in half the oil; remove.
Add remaining oil, peas and carrots, ginger, and scallion whites; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add rice and soy sauce; stir-fry 4 minutes until hot.
Fold in eggs, sesame oil, and scallion greens.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium soy sauce gives about 500 mg per serving; use 1 tbsp to halve it.

swaps.then: Use coconut aminos.
Use 1/2 cup diced firm tofu or cooked chicken.
Use only scallion greens.

name: Caprese farro salad
steps: Simmer farro in water 20 to 25 minutes until chewy-tender; drain and cool slightly.
Toss with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, arugula, oil, vinegar, and pepper.
Serve warm or cold. Keeps 3 days.

swaps.then: Use quinoa or brown rice instead of farro.
Use 1 can rinsed cannellini beans instead of mozzarella.
Skip the balsamic; use a squeeze of lemon or leave plain.

name: Savory cottage cheese bowl with cucumber and tomato
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with cucumber, tomatoes, seeds, olive oil, and plenty of pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: Cottage cheese has about 700 mg per cup; low-sodium brands cut that in half.

swaps.then: Use lactose-free cottage cheese or Greek yogurt.
Use diced red bell pepper.

name: Homemade chicken noodle soup (batch)
steps: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in oil 5 minutes; add garlic 1 minute.
Add broth and whole chicken breasts; simmer 15 minutes until chicken is cooked.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to the pot.
Add noodles and simmer 7 minutes.
Finish with parsley and pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium broth is what keeps this at about 200 mg a bowl; regular broth would push it past 800.

swaps.then: Use rice noodles or 1 cup cooked rice.
Skip onion and garlic; use the green tops of scallions and gluten-free noodles.
Use plain pasta or rice instead of egg noodles.

name: Roasted sweet potato and black bean bowls

ingredients.display: 2 cans (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss sweet potatoes with half the oil, cumin, and chili powder; roast 25 minutes.
Massage kale with the rest of the oil and lime juice.
Warm beans and rice.
Build bowls: rice, beans, sweet potato, kale, avocado, pumpkin seeds.

swaps.then: Use 1/4 cup beans per bowl and add 3 oz chicken.
Use white rice instead of sweet potato and skip the avocado.

name: Sardine and tomato toast

ingredients.display: 1 can (3.75 oz) sardines in olive oil, drained

steps: Toast the bread.
Top with arugula, tomato, and sardines.
Squeeze lemon over and add pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: Sardines carry about 260 mg per can; rinse them or look for no-salt-added.

swaps.then: Use 1/2 cup white beans mashed with olive oil.
Use gluten-free bread or rice cakes.

name: Blended tomato basil soup

ingredients.display: 1/2 can cannellini beans, rinsed (for body and protein)
4 slices whole-wheat bread, toasted, for serving

steps: Cook onion in oil 5 minutes; add garlic 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, and beans; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend with the basil until smooth.
Stir in milk and pepper; warm through without boiling. Serve with toast.

notes.sodium_tip: Canned tomatoes, broth, and bread each add about 150 to 250 mg; no-salt-added tomatoes and low-sodium broth bring the bowl under 300 mg.

swaps.then: Serve with gluten-free bread or rice.
Use oat milk instead of milk.
Skip onion and garlic; add 1 tsp dried basil and a pinch of paprika.

name: Lentil salad with cucumber, tomato, and feta

ingredients.display: 1 cup dry green or brown lentils, rinsed

steps: Simmer lentils in water 20 minutes until tender but not mushy; drain and cool.
Whisk oil, lemon, cumin, and pepper.
Toss lentils with vegetables, parsley, and dressing; top with feta.
Keeps 4 days and travels well.

swaps.then: Skip the feta; add toasted walnuts.
Use 1/2 cup canned lentils (rinsed) per serving, which are lower in FODMAPs.
Leave out the red onion.

name: Pesto chicken pasta salad
steps: Cook pasta per package; drain and rinse briefly.
Blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, oil, garlic, and lemon into pesto.
Toss pasta with pesto, chicken, tomatoes, and spinach.

swaps.then: Use sunflower seeds in the pesto.
Use brown rice or chickpea pasta.
Skip the parmesan and add a pinch of salt to the pesto.

name: Shrimp rice noodle salad with lime and peanuts
steps: Soak or boil rice noodles per package; rinse in cold water.
Cook shrimp in oil over medium-high heat 2 minutes per side.
Whisk lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, and jalapeno.
Toss noodles with vegetables and dressing; top with shrimp, cilantro, and peanuts.

notes.sodium_tip: Fish sauce and shrimp put this near 900 mg; use 2 tsp fish sauce and untreated shrimp to cut it.

swaps.then: Use 1 lb sliced chicken breast; cook 6 minutes.
Use cashews or skip the nuts.
Use 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce instead of fish sauce.

name: Microwave baked potato with broccoli and cheddar
steps: Prick the potato all over and microwave 5 minutes; turn and microwave 3 to 4 minutes more until soft.
Microwave broccoli with a splash of water 2 minutes.
Split the potato, fluff, and top with broccoli, cheddar, yogurt, and pepper.

swaps.then: Top with 1/2 cup white beans and olive oil instead.
Use a smaller potato and soak the cut pieces in water 2 hours before cooking, or choose rice.

name: White bean and kale soup (batch, vegan)
steps: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in oil 6 minutes.
Add garlic and rosemary; stir 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, water, and beans; simmer 10 minutes.
Add pasta and simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Mash a cup of beans against the side of the pot to thicken; stir in kale until tender, 5 minutes.

notes.sodium_tip: Vegetable broth is cut with water to keep sodium near 450 mg a bowl; low-sodium broth would bring it under 300.

swaps.then: Use brown rice pasta or 1 cup cooked rice.
Not a good fit during elimination; choose the chicken rice congee.
Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens.

name: Chicken and ginger rice congee
steps: Combine rice, broth, water, ginger, and whole chicken breasts in a pot; bring to a boil.
Reduce to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, 45 to 50 minutes until the rice breaks down and thickens.
Remove chicken after 20 minutes, shred, and return it.
Serve with scallion greens, sesame oil, and pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: About 150 mg per bowl with low-sodium broth and no soy sauce.

swaps.then: Use 12 oz firm white fish added in the last 10 minutes.
Skip the sesame oil.

name: Sheet-pan salmon with broccoli and potatoes

ingredients.display: 1 lb salmon fillet, cut in 4 pieces

steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss potatoes with half the oil and roast 15 minutes.
Push potatoes aside; add broccoli tossed with the remaining oil and pepper.
Lay salmon on the pan, top with lemon slices, dill, and pepper.
Roast 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes.

swaps.then: Use 4 chicken breasts; roast 22 to 25 minutes.
Use very fresh salmon cooked the day you buy it, skip the lemon, and use dill only.

name: Chicken and broccoli stir-fry with brown rice

ingredients.display: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced thin

steps: Whisk soy sauce, cornstarch, and water for the sauce.
Stir-fry chicken in oil over high heat 5 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli and pepper 3 minutes; add garlic and ginger 30 seconds.
Return chicken, pour in sauce, and toss 1 minute until glossy. Finish with sesame oil; serve over rice.

notes.sodium_tip: Uses low-sodium soy sauce (about 250 mg per serving); regular soy sauce would add another 200 mg.

swaps.then: Use coconut aminos.
Use tamari or coconut aminos.
Skip the garlic; add extra ginger.

name: Turkey meatballs with whole-wheat spaghetti
steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Mix turkey, egg, oats, parmesan, 1 clove garlic, parsley, oregano, and pepper; form 16 meatballs.
Bake on a lined sheet 18 minutes.
Meanwhile warm oil with remaining garlic 1 minute; add tomatoes and basil and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti per package.
Add meatballs to the sauce and serve over pasta.

notes.sodium_tip: Homemade sauce from crushed tomatoes keeps this around 450 mg; jarred marinara would add 300 mg or more.

swaps.then: Use certified GF oats and brown rice spaghetti.
Use 2 tbsp milk or water in place of the egg; handle gently.
Skip the garlic; use garlic-free sauce and gluten-free pasta.

name: Slow-cooker chicken and vegetable stew

ingredients.display: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Put chicken, carrots, potatoes, onion, celery, garlic, broth, tomato paste, rosemary, and pepper in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours or high 3 to 4 hours.
Stir cornstarch into 2 tbsp cold water; stir in with the peas and cook 15 minutes more on high to thicken.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium broth and no added salt: about 200 mg per serving.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; add the green tops of scallions at the end.
Use 1 1/2 lb beef chuck cubes and cook on low 8 hours.

name: Pressure-cooker beef and vegetable stew

ingredients.display: 2 lb beef chuck roast, trimmed and cubed

steps: Brown beef in oil on the saute setting in two batches; remove.
Cook onion 3 minutes; add garlic and tomato paste 1 minute; add broth and scrape the bottom.
Return beef with paprika and pepper. Pressure cook 25 minutes; quick release.
Add potatoes and carrots; pressure cook 5 minutes; quick release.
Stir cornstarch into 2 tbsp cold water and simmer 2 minutes on saute to thicken.

notes.sodium_tip: Reduced-sodium broth keeps this near 250 mg; regular broth would add 150 mg per bowl.

swaps.then: Use 2 lb boneless chicken thighs; pressure cook 10 minutes instead of 25.
Skip onion and garlic; add a chopped leek green.

name: Baked cod with cherry tomatoes and olives

ingredients.display: 3 cups cooked brown rice, for serving

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Toss tomatoes, olives, garlic, oil, and oregano in a baking dish; roast 10 minutes.
Nestle cod into the tomatoes, season with pepper, and bake 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley. Serve over the rice.

notes.sodium_tip: Cod is naturally saltier than most fish and the olives add more; skip olives to cut about 100 mg.

swaps.then: Use thin-sliced chicken breast; bake 20 minutes.
Skip the garlic; use a pinch more oregano.

name: One-pot chicken, rice, and peas

ingredients.display: 1 1/3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut in pieces

steps: Brown chicken in oil over medium-high heat 5 minutes; remove.
Cook onion and carrot 4 minutes; add garlic, rice, turmeric, and paprika and stir 1 minute.
Add broth and chicken; cover and simmer on low 18 minutes.
Scatter peas on top, cover, and rest 5 minutes off the heat; fluff.

notes.sodium_tip: About 150 mg per serving with low-sodium broth.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; add scallion greens at the end.
Use brown rice and add 3/4 cup more broth; simmer 40 minutes.

name: Coconut lentil and cauliflower curry
steps: Cook onion in oil 5 minutes; add garlic, ginger, and spices for 1 minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk, and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Add cauliflower; simmer 10 minutes until lentils and cauliflower are tender.
Stir in spinach and lime juice. Serve over rice.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; use canned lentils (rinsed) at 1/2 cup per serving and swap cauliflower for carrots.
Skip the chili powder.

name: Crispy tofu and vegetable stir-fry

ingredients.display: 1 block (14 oz) extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed

steps: Toss tofu with 1 tbsp cornstarch. Pan-fry in oil over medium-high heat 8 minutes, turning, until golden; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, pepper, and snap peas 4 minutes; add garlic and ginger 30 seconds.
Whisk soy sauce, water, and remaining cornstarch; add with tofu and toss until glossy.
Finish with sesame oil; serve over rice.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium soy sauce keeps this near 300 mg per serving.

swaps.then: Use 1 lb sliced chicken breast and coconut aminos.
Use tamari.
Skip the garlic.

name: Roasted sweet potato and black bean tacos

ingredients.display: 2 cans (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed

steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss sweet potatoes with oil, cumin, and chili powder; roast 25 minutes.
Warm beans in a small pan.
Toss cabbage with lime juice.
Warm tortillas; fill with sweet potato, beans, cabbage, avocado, cilantro, and a dab of yogurt.

swaps.then: Skip the yogurt; use extra avocado.
Use 1/4 cup beans per serving and add shredded chicken.
Use cauliflower instead of sweet potato and skip the avocado.

name: Turkey burgers on whole-grain buns
steps: Mix turkey, onion, garlic powder, paprika, egg, oats, and pepper; form 4 patties with a dimple in the center.
Cook in oil over medium heat 5 to 6 minutes per side to 165 F.
Serve on buns with lettuce, tomato, and mustard.

notes.sodium_tip: The bun is the salt here (about 220 mg); a lettuce wrap drops the burger to about 150 mg.

swaps.then: Use certified GF oats and gluten-free buns or lettuce wraps.
Skip the egg; add 1 tbsp water and chill patties 10 minutes.
Skip onion and garlic powder; use chives.

name: Air-fryer chicken thighs with brussels sprouts and sweet potato
steps: Toss chicken with half the oil, paprika, garlic powder, and pepper.
Air-fry chicken at 380 F for 18 minutes, flipping once.
Toss vegetables with the rest of the oil; air-fry at 390 F for 12 minutes, shaking halfway (cook in batches if needed).

swaps.then: Use green beans instead of brussels sprouts.
Skip garlic powder; use smoked paprika and pepper.

name: Roast pork tenderloin with apples and onions
steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss potatoes with half the oil on a sheet pan; roast 10 minutes.
Rub pork with mustard, rosemary, and pepper.
Add apples and onion tossed with the remaining oil and vinegar; set pork on top.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes to 145 F internal. Rest 5 minutes and slice.

swaps.then: Use 4 chicken breasts; roast 22 minutes.
Skip the onion; add carrots.
Use firm pears no more than 1/4 each, or carrots instead of apples.

name: Shrimp pasta with zucchini and tomatoes
steps: Cook pasta per package; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Cook zucchini in oil 4 minutes; add garlic and tomatoes 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon, parsley, parmesan, pepper, and a splash of pasta water.

notes.sodium_tip: Most bagged shrimp is treated with a salt solution; look for untreated shrimp to cut about 300 mg per serving.

swaps.then: Use 1 lb diced chicken breast; cook 6 minutes.
Use brown rice pasta.
Skip parmesan; add toasted pine nuts.

name: Roast chicken breast with carrots, zucchini, and potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425 F. Toss potatoes and carrots with half the oil; roast 15 minutes.
Rub chicken with the remaining oil, oregano, paprika, and pepper.
Add chicken and zucchini to the pan; roast 20 minutes more to 165 F.
Rest 5 minutes and slice.

notes.sodium_tip: No salt, no garlic, no citrus: about 120 mg per serving. Good base for low-histamine and low-FODMAP plans.

swaps.then: Use 4 pork loin chops; roast 18 minutes.

name: Slow-cooker BBQ pulled chicken with yogurt slaw
steps: Put chicken, onion, barbecue sauce, 1 tbsp vinegar, and paprika in the slow cooker; cook on low 4 hours.
Shred chicken with two forks and stir into the juices.
Toss cabbage and carrot with yogurt, remaining vinegar, honey, and pepper.
Pile chicken and slaw onto buns.

notes.sodium_tip: Bottled barbecue sauce is about 370 mg per serving here; a low-sodium sauce or half the amount plus extra vinegar cuts it.

swaps.then: Use 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp vinegar, and smoked paprika instead of bottled sauce.
Serve over baked potatoes or rice.
Skip the onion and choose a sauce without garlic or onion.

name: Spaghetti squash with turkey bolognese

ingredients.display: 1 medium spaghetti squash (about 4 cups cooked strands)

steps: Halve the squash, scoop seeds, and microwave cut side down with 2 tbsp water 12 minutes until tender; scrape into strands.
Brown turkey in oil; add onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add garlic 1 minute, then tomatoes and herbs; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve sauce over squash with parmesan.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens and extra carrot.
Skip the parmesan.
Use 1 lb 90% lean ground beef or 2 cups cooked lentils.

name: Canned salmon cakes with green salad
steps: Mash salmon (bones included) with egg, oats, scallions, dill, mustard, lemon, and pepper; form 8 small cakes.
Pan-fry in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat 4 minutes per side.
Toss lettuce and cucumber with the remaining oil and vinegar. Serve 2 cakes per person with rice.

notes.sodium_tip: Canned salmon carries about 300 mg per serving; no-salt-added cans exist.

swaps.then: Use 2 tbsp Greek yogurt as the binder and chill the cakes 15 minutes.
Use certified GF oats.
Use 2 cans rinsed chickpeas, mashed, for chickpea cakes.

name: Skillet chicken fajitas with corn tortillas

ingredients.display: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, sliced

steps: Toss chicken with chili powder, cumin, paprika, and garlic powder.
Cook chicken in oil over high heat 5 minutes; remove.
Cook peppers and onion 5 minutes until charred at the edges; return chicken and add lime juice.
Serve in warm tortillas with yogurt and salsa.

notes.sodium_tip: Corn tortillas instead of flour save about 300 mg per serving; salsa is the remaining salt source.

swaps.then: Skip onion and garlic powder; use extra peppers.
Use avocado instead of yogurt.

name: Mushroom barley soup (batch, vegan)
steps: Cook onion, carrot, and celery in oil 5 minutes; add mushrooms and cook 6 minutes until browned.
Add garlic 1 minute, then barley, broth, and water.
Simmer 25 to 30 minutes until barley is tender; add beans for the last 5 minutes.
Finish with parsley and pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: Broth is cut with water to keep this near 400 mg a bowl; low-sodium broth brings it under 200.

swaps.then: Use brown rice or buckwheat instead of barley.
Use oyster mushrooms only, or swap for zucchini.
Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens.

name: Whole-wheat pita pizzas with vegetables
steps: Heat oven to 425 F.
Mix puree with oregano and garlic powder; spread on pitas.
Top with cheese, peppers, mushrooms, and spinach.
Bake directly on the rack 10 minutes until the cheese bubbles.

notes.sodium_tip: Pita and mozzarella total about 570 mg; plain tomato puree instead of jarred sauce saves 200 mg.

swaps.then: Use a gluten-free flatbread or corn tortillas (bake 6 minutes).
Skip the cheese; add white beans and extra vegetables with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Baked tilapia with cilantro lime rice and black beans

ingredients.display: 1 can (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed and warmed

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Rub fish with oil, cumin, paprika, pepper, and half the lime juice.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until it flakes.
Toss hot rice with cilantro and remaining lime juice.
Serve fish over rice with beans alongside.

swaps.then: Use thin chicken cutlets; bake 18 minutes.
Skip the beans; add sauteed zucchini.
Use brown rice.

name: Ground beef taco bowls
steps: Brown beef over medium-high heat 6 minutes; drain fat.
Stir in spices and tomato puree; simmer 3 minutes.
Warm beans and rice.
Build bowls: rice, romaine, beef, beans, tomato, cheese, yogurt, salsa.

notes.sodium_tip: Homemade taco seasoning instead of a packet saves about 300 mg; salsa and cheese are what remains.

swaps.then: Use 1 lb ground turkey.
Skip cheese and yogurt; add avocado.
Skip the beans; double the rice and vegetables.

name: Poached chicken with mashed potatoes and soft carrots

ingredients.display: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps: Bring broth to a bare simmer; add chicken, cover, and poach 15 minutes until 165 F. Slice or shred.
Boil potatoes 15 minutes until very tender; drain and mash with warm milk, butter, and pepper.
Simmer carrots 12 minutes until soft; toss with olive oil and parsley.
Plate chicken with potatoes and carrots; spoon a little poaching broth over the chicken.

notes.sodium_tip: About 150 mg per serving; a gentle, low-fiber plate for flare days.

swaps.then: Mash with lactose-free milk.
Mash with olive oil and a little poaching broth.
Use white rice instead of potatoes.

name: Mushroom parmesan risotto

ingredients.display: 1 1/2 cups arborio or short-grain white rice

steps: Brown mushrooms in half the oil over medium-high heat 6 minutes; remove.
Cook onion in the remaining oil 3 minutes; add garlic and rice and stir 1 minute.
Add hot broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring often, waiting until absorbed before the next; about 20 minutes total.
Stir in mushrooms, parmesan, butter, parsley, and pepper. Serve at once.

notes.sodium_tip: Broth diluted with water plus parmesan lands near 650 mg; low-sodium broth brings it under 400.

swaps.then: Skip parmesan and butter; finish with 1 tbsp olive oil and lemon zest.
Use oyster mushrooms or swap mushrooms for peas.
Skip onion and garlic; use scallion greens.

name: Seared scallops with pea puree

ingredients.display: 1 lb sea scallops, patted very dry

steps: Soften onion in butter 3 minutes; add peas and water and simmer 4 minutes. Blend smooth with lemon and pepper.
Heat oil in a heavy pan until shimmering; add scallops without crowding.
Sear 2 minutes per side without moving them until deeply golden.
Spoon puree onto plates, top with scallops and parsley; serve with rice.

swaps.then: Scallops are mollusks, not crustaceans, but if you avoid all shellfish use cod pieces seared 3 minutes per side.
Use olive oil instead of butter.
Skip the onion.

name: Baked falafel pitas with tahini sauce

ingredients.display: 2 cans (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and patted dry

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, cumin, and pepper in a blender or food processor until coarse, not pureed.
Stir in flour and baking powder; form 16 patties and brush both sides with oil.
Bake 12 minutes, flip, and bake 12 more until crisp.
Whisk tahini, lemon, and water into a sauce.
Stuff pita halves with falafel, cucumber, tomato, and sauce.

swaps.then: Use a plain Greek yogurt and lemon sauce instead of tahini.
Use chickpea or rice flour and serve in lettuce cups.
Not a fit during elimination; try the roast chicken breast with vegetables.

name: Pan-seared steak with chimichurri and sauteed spinach

ingredients.display: 1 lb top round or sirloin steak, 1 inch thick

steps: Finely chop parsley, cilantro, and garlic; stir with 2 tbsp oil, vinegar, oregano, and half the pepper for the chimichurri.
Pat steak dry and season with pepper. Sear in a very hot pan 4 minutes per side for medium-rare; rest 8 minutes.
Wilt spinach in the same pan with the remaining oil, 2 minutes.
Slice steak thinly against the grain; serve with chimichurri, spinach, and rice.

swaps.then: Use chicken breast pounded thin; sear 4 minutes per side.
Use sauteed zucchini instead of spinach.
Skip the garlic in the chimichurri.

name: Lightened chicken tikka masala

ingredients.display: 1 1/3 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed

steps: Toss chicken with yogurt, half the garlic and ginger, turmeric, cumin, and half the paprika; marinate 15 minutes (or overnight).
Broil chicken on a lined sheet 8 to 10 minutes until charred at the edges.
Cook onion in oil 5 minutes; add remaining garlic, ginger, paprika, and chili powder 1 minute.
Add tomato puree and simmer 8 minutes; stir in coconut milk and chicken and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve over rice with cilantro.

notes.sodium_tip: Unsalted tomato puree keeps this near 250 mg; jarred simmer sauce would be 600 mg or more.

swaps.then: Marinate in coconut milk with lemon juice instead of yogurt.
Skip onion and garlic; double the ginger.
Skip the chili powder.

name: Oven-braised chicken thighs with white beans and kale
steps: Heat oven to 375 F. Brown chicken in oil in a Dutch oven 4 minutes per side; remove.
Cook onion and carrot 5 minutes; add garlic and rosemary 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, broth, and beans; nestle chicken on top.
Cover and bake 30 minutes; stir in kale and bake uncovered 10 minutes more.

notes.sodium_tip: Rinsed canned beans and low-sodium broth keep this around 450 mg.

swaps.then: Use diced potatoes instead of beans.
Skip onion and garlic; use leek greens.

name: Whole-wheat pasta primavera
steps: Cook pasta per package; add asparagus and peas for the last 3 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water; drain.
Cook zucchini in oil 4 minutes; add garlic and tomatoes 2 minutes.
Toss everything with parmesan, lemon, basil, pepper, and pasta water as needed.

swaps.then: Use brown rice or chickpea pasta.
Skip parmesan; add toasted pine nuts.
Skip garlic and asparagus; use gluten-free pasta and bell pepper.

name: Pinto bean and rice skillet
steps: Cook onion and pepper in oil 5 minutes; add garlic and spices 1 minute.
Stir in rice, tomatoes, and broth; cover and simmer 18 minutes.
Fold in beans, cover, and cook 5 minutes.
Top with cheese and let it melt, covered, 2 minutes.

notes.sodium_tip: Rinsed canned beans and broth cut with water: about 700 mg. Low-sodium broth and home-cooked beans would cut it in half.

swaps.then: Skip the cheese; top with avocado.
Not a fit during elimination.
Use brown rice and simmer 40 minutes with 1/2 cup more broth.

name: Slow-cooker three-bean vegetarian chili

ingredients.display: 2 cans (15 oz) low-sodium black beans, rinsed

steps: Combine everything in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours.
Taste and add pepper. Serve with rice, over baked potatoes, or on its own. Freezes well.

notes.sodium_tip: Rinsed beans and low-sodium black beans keep this near 450 mg a bowl.

swaps.then: Not a fit during elimination.
Use 1 tbsp chili powder.

name: Fish tacos with lime cabbage slaw
steps: Rub fish with chili powder and cumin; cook in oil over medium-high heat 3 to 4 minutes per side; flake.
Toss cabbage with half the lime juice; mix yogurt with the rest.
Warm tortillas; fill with fish, slaw, avocado, cilantro, and lime yogurt.

swaps.then: Use sliced chicken breast; cook 6 minutes.
Use extra avocado mashed with lime instead of yogurt.
Use 2 tbsp avocado per serving.

name: Honey ginger salmon rice bowls with bok choy

ingredients.display: 1 lb salmon fillet, cut in 4 pieces

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Whisk honey, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic; brush half over the salmon.
Bake salmon 12 minutes.
Sear bok choy cut side down in sesame oil 3 minutes; add 2 tbsp water, cover, and steam 2 minutes.
Serve salmon and bok choy over rice with the remaining sauce and scallions.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium soy sauce contributes about 250 mg per bowl.

swaps.then: Use coconut aminos.
Use chicken thighs; bake 22 minutes.
Skip the honey; add 1 tsp rice vinegar.

name: Unstuffed cabbage skillet with beef and rice
steps: Brown beef in oil with onion 7 minutes; drain fat. Add garlic 1 minute.
Add cabbage, tomatoes, tomato paste, paprika, and pepper; cover and simmer 15 minutes until cabbage is tender.
Stir in rice and heat through.

notes.sodium_tip: No added salt; canned tomatoes are the main source at about 130 mg per serving.

swaps.then: Use ground turkey.
Skip onion and garlic; cabbage is fine at 3/4 cup per serving.

name: Microwave sweet potato with black beans and salsa
steps: Prick the sweet potato and microwave 5 minutes; turn and microwave 3 to 4 minutes more until soft.
Microwave beans 1 minute.
Split the potato and top with beans, cheese, salsa, yogurt, and scallion.

swaps.then: Skip cheese and yogurt; add avocado.
Use 3 oz cooked chicken instead of beans.
Use a small white potato soaked in water before cooking.

name: Microwave ginger scallion fish with rice and bok choy

ingredients.display: 1 cup cooked white rice (microwave pouch is fine)

steps: Lay fish and bok choy in a microwave-safe dish; top with ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Cover loosely and microwave 3 to 4 minutes until the fish flakes.
Heat rice and serve the fish and juices over it.

notes.sodium_tip: Low-sodium soy sauce; about 350 mg total.

swaps.then: Skip the soy sauce; use ginger, scallion, and a pinch of salt.
Use a thin chicken cutlet; microwave 5 to 6 minutes to 165 F.
Use coconut aminos.

name: Rotisserie chicken, rice, and broccoli plate

ingredients.display: 4 oz rotisserie chicken breast, skin removed

steps: Microwave broccoli with a splash of water 3 minutes; drain.
Heat rice per package and warm the chicken 1 minute.
Toss broccoli with oil, lemon, and pepper; plate everything.

notes.sodium_tip: Rotisserie chicken is the salt here (about 390 mg for 4 oz); plain baked chicken breast drops the plate under 150 mg.

swaps.then: Use a 5 oz can of no-salt-added salmon.

name: Apple slices with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple.
Dip in peanut butter.

swaps.then: Use almond or sunflower seed butter.
Use a firm banana or an orange instead of apple.

name: Hummus with carrots and cucumber
steps: Portion hummus into a small bowl.
Dip the vegetables.

notes.sodium_tip: About 300 mg from the hummus; lower-sodium brands cut this in half.

swaps.then: Use a tahini-free bean dip.
Keep hummus to 2 tbsp.

name: DIY trail mix (batch)
steps: Mix everything in a jar.
Portion 1/3 cup per serving.

swaps.then: Use roasted chickpeas and sunflower seeds in place of the nuts.
Use dried cranberries instead of raisins and keep almonds to 10 per serving.

name: Hard-boiled eggs (batch)
steps: Cover eggs with cold water in a pot; bring to a boil.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let stand 11 minutes.
Cool in ice water and peel. Refrigerate up to 5 days; 2 eggs per serving.

swaps.then: Choose the roasted chickpea or hummus snack instead.

name: Rice cakes with almond butter and banana
steps: Spread almond butter on the rice cakes.
Top with banana slices.

swaps.then: Use peanut or sunflower seed butter.

name: Microwave paper-bag popcorn with parmesan
steps: Put 2 tbsp popcorn kernels in a paper lunch bag; fold the top over twice.
Microwave 2 to 3 minutes until pops slow to 2 seconds apart.
Toss with olive oil, parmesan, and pepper.

swaps.then: Skip the parmesan; use a pinch of smoked paprika.

name: Cottage cheese with peaches
steps: Top cottage cheese with peach slices.

swaps.then: Use lactose-free cottage cheese or Greek yogurt.
Use 1/2 cup strawberries instead of peach.

name: Steamed edamame in the pod

ingredients.display: 1 cup frozen edamame (shelled, or 2 cups in pods)

steps: Microwave edamame with 1 tbsp water, covered, 3 minutes.
Season with pepper.

notes.sodium_tip: Skip the flaky salt most recipes call for; edamame is under 10 mg on its own.

swaps.then: Use steamed snap peas or roasted chickpeas.
Keep to 1/2 cup shelled.

name: Peanut butter oat energy bites (batch)
steps: Stir everything together until it holds when squeezed; add 1 tbsp water if dry.
Roll into 16 balls.
Refrigerate 30 minutes; keeps 1 week in the fridge. Two bites per serving.

swaps.then: Use sunflower seed butter.
Use certified gluten-free oats.
Use 2 mashed dates instead of honey and skip the chocolate.

name: Swiss cheese, grapes, and whole-wheat crackers
steps: Arrange on a plate and eat.

notes.sodium_tip: Swiss is one of the lowest-sodium cheeses; the crackers carry most of the salt here.

swaps.then: Use brown rice cakes.
Use 2 tbsp almond butter with the crackers.

name: Ginger chicken and vegetable rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice in plenty of water until tender, about 15 minutes; drain.
Heat the canola oil in a wide pan over high heat. Add the chicken with the salt and cook, turning, until browned and cooked through, 6 to 8 minutes. Lift out.
Add the carrot and zucchini to the pan and stir-fry 3 minutes. Add the ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the sesame oil and spring onion tops, toss, and serve over the rice.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.
Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Herb-roasted chicken thighs with potatoes and carrots
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F).
Toss the potatoes and carrots with half the oil, half the salt, and the rosemary on a large baking tray. Roast 20 minutes.

Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil and salt and the thyme leaves. Nestle among the vegetables and roast 25 to 30 minutes more, until the chicken reaches 74 °C (165 °F) and the potatoes are golden.

name: Baked cod with chive butter and rice
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Cook the rice in plenty of water until tender; drain.
Mix the butter with the chives and a pinch of salt.
Lay the cod in a baking dish, season with salt, and top with the chive butter. Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Steam the broccoli 4 minutes. Serve the fish over the rice with the broccoli and the melted butter spooned over.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.
Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Turkey and zucchini patties with cucumber salad
steps: Mix the turkey, zucchini, egg, rice flour, chives, cumin, and salt. Shape into 8 patties.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Cook the patties 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned and cooked through (74 °C / 165 °F).
Toss the cucumber with the dill and a pinch of salt. Serve alongside.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.

name: Quinoa bowl with roasted pepper, cucumber, and pumpkin seeds

ingredients.display: 1 red bell pepper, fresh-roasted and sliced
a handful of fresh basil, torn

steps: Roast the whole pepper under a hot grill, turning, until the skin chars, about 10 minutes. Cover it for 5 minutes, then peel and slice. Use a fresh pepper, not one from a jar.
Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa and simmer in 1½ cups water, covered, 15 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.
Toss the warm quinoa with the oil and salt, then fold in the pepper, cucumber, carrot, and basil.
Top with the pumpkin seeds.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.
Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Banana and chia porridge
steps: Simmer the oats, milk, and chia in a small pan, stirring, 4 to 5 minutes until thick.
Stir in the cinnamon. Top with the banana and maple syrup.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.

name: Blueberry pancakes (rice flour and oats)

ingredients.display: 1 tbsp maple syrup, plus more to serve
2 tsp canola oil for the pan

steps: Whisk the rice flour, oats, baking powder, and salt. Whisk in the egg, milk, and maple syrup to a thick batter; rest 5 minutes.
Heat a little oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Pour ¼-cup rounds, scatter blueberries on top, and cook 2 minutes until bubbles form; flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve with extra maple syrup.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.
Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Chive scrambled eggs on rice cakes
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt and chives.
Melt the butter in a small pan over low heat and stir the eggs slowly until just set.
Pile onto the rice cakes.

Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Carrot and ginger soup
steps: Use plain water, or a quick vegetable stock you simmered under 30 minutes without onion or garlic. Warm the oil in a pot and cook the carrot, potato, and ginger 5 minutes.
Add the stock, turmeric, and salt. Simmer 20 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Blend smooth, stir in the coconut milk, and reheat gently.

name: Pumpkin and coconut soup with cumin

ingredients.display: 800 g pumpkin or squash, cubed (or 2 cans pumpkin purée)

steps: Use plain water, or a quick vegetable stock you simmered under 30 minutes without onion or garlic. Warm the oil in a pot; cook the ginger and cumin 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, stock, and salt. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until soft.
Blend smooth with the coconut milk. Serve with the spring onion tops on top.

name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the beef with the cornstarch and half the salt.
Heat the garlic-infused oil in a wok over high heat. Sear the beef in two batches, 2 minutes each; lift out.
Add the broccoli, ginger, and water. Cover and steam 3 minutes. Return the beef, add the sesame oil and remaining salt, and toss until glossy. Serve over the rice.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.

name: Baked trout with dill and buttered potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Boil the potatoes 15 minutes until tender; drain and toss with the butter and chives.
Lay the trout on a lined tray, brush with oil, and season with dill and salt. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes.
Serve together.

written_for: Written for the low FODMAP elimination phase: no onion, garlic, wheat, lactose, honey, or the high-FODMAP fruit and vegetables in the Monash-group lists.
Written for a low histamine trial along the SIGHI list: fresh meat and fish, no tomato, spinach, aged cheese, cured meat, vinegar, or fermented sauces. Eat it fresh; do not keep leftovers.

name: Chicken and rice noodle soup with chard
steps: Use plain water, or a quick vegetable stock you simmered under 30 minutes without onion or garlic. Bring the stock, ginger, and salt to a simmer. Add the chicken and carrot and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the chard and cook 2 minutes.
